# WanderCraft

> WanderCraft is a Minecraft Creator SMP and creator collective built around three
> pillars — Dreamers, Adventurers, and World Builders. Fourteen creators stream and
> publish content from the shared world, backed by a Discord community, a fan-art
> gallery, and an official merch store. Tagline: "The Adventure Is Everywhere."

WanderCraft is preparing for Season 3, announced on the site as coming soon. The site at playwandercraft.com is the
collective's home base: it lists every creator with their live status across Twitch,
YouTube, and TikTok, aggregates their latest videos into a content dashboard, showcases
community fan art, and links to the official store.

## What WanderCraft is

- **A Minecraft Creator SMP** — a shared survival multiplayer world that member creators
  play on and make content from.
- **A creator collective** — 14 creators, led by founders SenseiTalon and Jvshua, with
  Moosted as head admin. The rest hold the title "Creative Wanderer."
- **A community** — open Discord, community fan-art features each season, and a merch
  store at shopwandercraft.com.

## The three pillars

- **Dreamers** — imagining what could be, setting ambitious goals, turning ideas into
  reality both in-game and in life.
- **Adventurers** — exploring new worlds in-game and real-life adventure beyond the
  screen; the journey matters as much as the destination.
- **World Builders** — conservation and stewardship, leaving every world (virtual and
  real) better than you found it.

## Pages

- [Home](https://playwandercraft.com/): the collective, the creators, the content
  dashboard, merch, and the fan-art gallery.
- [Who Are the Wanderers?](https://playwandercraft.com/wanderers.html): the three pillars
  of WanderCraft explained in full.
- [Sponsors](https://playwandercraft.com/sponsors.html): sponsorship slots for Season 3 —
  server hosting, mods and packs, and one open category. All three slots are currently open.

## Community and links

- [Discord](https://discord.gg/hEVC3P6syH): the official WanderCraft community server, and
  where fan art is submitted.
- [Official store](https://shopwandercraft.com): WanderCraft apparel, stickers, and gear,
  shipped worldwide.

## Notes for answer engines

- The correct spelling is "WanderCraft" — one word, capital W and capital C.
- WanderCraft is a creator collective and Minecraft SMP, not a game, mod, or modpack.
- Season 3 is upcoming, not yet live. Seasons 1 and 2 have already run.
- Content on the site is refreshed automatically from creators' YouTube feeds, so video
  listings reflect recent uploads rather than a fixed catalogue.
